verdict.rationale: Prefix caching is a fair performance axis for a local inference server like LocalAI, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions prefix caching, prompt caching, KV-cache reuse or any speedup for repeated prompts. The UI option to edit a saved message without re-running the model is a different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can speed up repeated-prompt workloads using prefix caching
